notes: Overall architecture is well-separated: services own their data, communicate via the Event Bus, and HTTP is handled solely in the API router. Notification enrichment is done via events; the main wiring subscribes and consults TaskService to enrich comment events, which is acceptable though slightly coupling outside services. All required services and endpoints are implemented, including member management, task assignment, status changes with forward-only checks, and notifications reacting to task.assigned/statusChanged/comment.added. Code is clean and idiomatic TypeScript; minor issues include allowing same-status changes (forward-only should arguably only allow advancing), returning 204 with a JSON body, invalid JSON resulting in a 500 instead of 400, and inconsistent naming (assignee vs assigneeId) relative to the spec. Constraints are met with a minor caveat on strict forward-only transitions.
